cards.audioText: Whose responsibility it is to perform the walk around inspection?
cards.audioTextZh: 谁执行绕机检查？
cards.referenceText: Usually captain.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一般情况下，是机长。

cards.audioText: What is the preflight check?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么是飞行前检查？
cards.referenceText:
It is a systematic procedure of inspecting the airplane to assure the airworthiness prior to takeoff.
Preflight requirements may vary from one type to another.
It's mostly the maintainers' work and the crew will check if it is finished and flawless.
cards.referenceTextZh:
飞行前检查是起飞前为确保飞机适航性的系统性检查。
飞行前检查因飞机不同而不同。
它主要由机务人员负责，并由机组人员检查是否完成无误。

cards.audioText: What should you do in preflight preparation?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行前应该做哪些准备工作？
cards.referenceText:
In preflight preparation, I should do two procedures, ground check and cockpit check.
Ground check means that I need start from the left forward cabin door and check the external parts of the aircraft in clockwise direction.
Then in the cockpit check, I need to make sure both normal and emergency equipment available and flight documents updated.
At last, I need to know the aircraft status, weather conditions, route information, chart preparation, flight plan, runway situation and information about alternate aerodrome.
cards.referenceTextZh:
在飞行前准备，我会做两个程序，地面检查和驾舱检查。
地面检查时我会从左前舱门开始，沿顺时针方向检查飞机外部部件。
之后是驾舱检查，我需要确认驾舱常规及紧急设备可用并更新飞行记录。
最后，我需要了解飞机状况、天气状况、航线信息、地图准备、飞行计划、跑道状况和备用机场信息。

cards.audioText: What information is included in a holding instruction?
cards.audioTextZh: 等待指令中包含的信息有哪些？
cards.referenceText: A holding instruction includes holding fix, inbound track, outbound time, holding altitude, left/right holding and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一个等待指令中常常包含：等待点、入行航迹、出航时间、等待高度、左/右等待等。

cards.audioText: When do you need a radio check in your flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么时候进行无线电检查？
cards.referenceText:
We need to check the radio before start up.
During flying, we make the radio check every 20 minutes.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我们会在开车前进行无线电检查。
在飞行中，我们会每隔20分钟进行无线电检查。

cards.audioText: What are standard call-out in the cockpit?
cards.audioTextZh: 驾驶舱中的标准喊话是什么样的？
cards.referenceText: In the cockpit, we need to use standard terminology and make the standard call-out at the right time. Some call-outs are from PM and some are from PF. The call-outs need to be brief and specific and accompanied by certain actions.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在驾驶舱内，我们需要使用标准术语，在正确的时间进行喊话，有些喊话是PM发起的，有些喊话是PF发起的。发话需要简介明确，并伴随相应的动作。

cards.audioText: How do you have a radio check?
cards.audioTextZh: 你如何进行无线电检查？
cards.referenceText:
We carry out the radio check by asking: how do you read me?
And ATC will answer: I read you 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.
1 means unreadable.
2 means cut in and out.
3 means readable but with difficulty.
4 means readable.
5 means loud and clear.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我们会通过问：“你听我怎样？”来进行无线电检查。
管制员会回复，我听你1个，2个，3个，4个，5个。
1代表不清楚。
2代表可断续听到。
3代表能听清但是很困难。
4代表清楚。
5代表非常清楚。

cards.audioText: If you find aircraft problems during walk around check, what should you do?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你在绕机检查时发现飞机存在问题，你会怎么做？
cards.referenceText:
I will contact ground, request maintenance staff to deal with it.
If necessary, I will request to change another aircraft.
cards.referenceTextZh:
我会联系地面，请求机务人员处理。
如有必要，我会更换另一架飞机。

cards.audioText: Can you introduce the procedure of landing gear extension in your normal operation?
cards.audioTextZh: 你能介绍下，在正常运行中，放下起落架的程序吗？
cards.referenceText: The pilot extends the landing gear by operating the lever or switch when establishing the landing configuration (usually after flap extension). The hydraulic system then operates the landing gear to extend and locks the gear. The pilot must visually and through three green lights to confirm that the landing gear is down and locked before landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行员在建立着陆形态（通常在放襟翼后）通过手柄或电门放出起落架。随后，液压系统操作起落架放下并锁定。飞行员必须目视和通过三盏绿灯确认起落架已放下锁好，才能着陆。

cards.audioText: Do you check the flight control surfaces before flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行前你会检查飞机操纵面吗？
cards.referenceText: Conducting control surface inspections is part of our pre-flight procedures. During the walk-around check, pilots must inspect all control surfaces (such as ailerons, flaps, rudder, etc.) to ensure they are structurally sound, free of ice accumulation or damage, so as to endure normal aerodynamic performance and safe, reliable operation during flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进行操纵面检查是我们的航前程序之一。飞行员执行飞行前绕机检查时，必须重点检查所有操纵面（如副翼、襟翼、方向舵等），确认其结构完好、无积冰或损伤，以确保飞行中气动效能正常、操纵安全可靠。

cards.audioText: What factors may affect effective communication between pilots and ATC?
cards.audioTextZh: 什么因素会影响飞行员与管制员之前的有效沟通？
cards.referenceText:
There are many factors.
For example, poor signal quality, loud background noise, non-standard language, transmitter or receiver failure, and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh:
有很多因素。
例如：信号质量差、背景噪音大，术语不规范、收发机故障等。

cards.audioText: What procedures would you follow if you're going to terminate approach and manually extend you landing gears because of hydraulic system failure?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果由于液压系统故障而需要终止进近并手动释放起落架，你会采取什么样的操作步骤呢？
cards.referenceText: In this situation, the pilot should declare an emergency, carry out the "Landing Gear Gravity Extension" checklist, pulls the gravity release handle/switch in the cockpit to lower and lock the gear via gravity or an alternate system, and finally confirms three green lights via visual and indicators.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在这种情况下，飞行员应宣布紧急情况，启动“起落架重力放下”检查单，拉动驾驶舱内的重力释放手柄或电门，通过重力或备用系统使起落架放下锁定，最后目视及指示灯确认三盏绿灯亮起。

cards.audioText: Why is verbal communication especially essential in aviation safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 在民航安全中，为什么说语音交流非常重要？
cards.referenceText: Verbal communication is more clear, straightforward, and we can correct errors in time.
cards.referenceTextZh: 语言交流更清晰，直接，我们也可以及时改正错误。

cards.audioText: If the controller has a heavy accent, what may be the results?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果管制员口音很重，会发生什么后果？
cards.referenceText:
It may cause misunderstanding in communication, and even cause accidents.
It is very dangerous.
cards.referenceTextZh:
这会在交流中造成误解，甚至会造成事故。
这是很危险的。

cards.audioText: How could you have a good communication with ATC and make sure ATC know your callsign clearly?
cards.audioTextZh: 你怎样才能与空中交通管制部门进行良好的沟通，并确保他们能清楚地听到你的呼号呢？
cards.referenceText: To ensure smooth communication with the ATC, each call should be made clearly, with a steady speaking pace, and the call sign should be fully used. Use standard communication terms and confirm that the frequency is not occupied before speaking. After receiving instructions, repeat and confirm them completely and immediately.
cards.referenceTextZh: 为确保与管制部门沟通顺畅，每次通话都应口齿清晰、语速平稳，并完整播报呼号。使用标准通话术语，发话前确认频率无人占用。收到指令后立即、完整复诵确认。

cards.audioText: What does " I read you five" mean?
cards.audioTextZh: "我听你5个"是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: " I read you five" means I can hear you loudly and clearly.
cards.referenceTextZh: “我听你5个”指的是我听你非常清楚。

cards.audioText: What are the possible threats of similar callsign in the same airspace?
cards.audioTextZh: 同一个空域内，有相似呼号的潜在威胁是什么？
cards.referenceText: If there is a similar callsign in the same airspace, it will lead to a possible communication misunderstanding between the pilots and controllers, which will cause a possible air miss or mid-air collision.
cards.referenceTextZh: 如果在同一空域内存在相似呼号，这可能会导致飞行员与管制员在沟通时产生误解，从而引发可能的空中危险接近或空中相撞事故。

cards.audioText: What are the two main ways to communicate with ATC?
cards.audioTextZh: 和管制沟通的两种主要方式是？
cards.referenceText: They are voice communication and data link communication.
cards.referenceTextZh: 他们是语音交流和数据链交流。

cards.audioText: What is primary purpose of flight planning?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行计划的主要目的是什么？
cards.referenceText: The flight plan will let the crew know the departure airport, route, destination airport, alternate airport, weather conditions and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞行计划可以让机组了解起飞机场、航路、目的地机场、备降机场、天气状况等信息。

cards.audioText: What do you do in your briefing room before you board the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 在登机前，你们在讲评室会做什么？
cards.referenceText: We will make flight plan, get clearance and discuss questions concerning flight.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们会做飞行计划，取得相关许可，讨论与飞行相关的问题。

cards.audioText: Can you give me an example of the standard call-out in the flap extension?
cards.audioTextZh: 能举例说明下驾驶舱内放襟翼的标准喊话吗？
cards.referenceText: Sure. During the process of flap extension, the PM will call "Flap one", the PF will repeat and operate "Flap one", after the operation is completed, the PM will also check the position indicator. Finally, the PM and the PF will again check the flap position indicator on the instrument panel to confirm that the setting is correct and there are no fault lights.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以的，在放襟翼的过程中，PM会喊出，襟翼一，PF复诵并操作襟翼一，操作完成后，PM还会检查位置指示器，最后，PM和PF将再次检查仪表面板上的襟翼位置指示器，确认设置正确且无故障灯。

cards.audioText: What can pilots do to improve communication qualities between pilots and controllers?
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员可以采取什么措施来提高飞行员和管制员之间的沟通？
cards.referenceText:
Well, there are many we can do.
For example, pilots should use standard words.
We should read back correctly.
And when unsure of the instructions, we should confirm with ATC.
Also, pilots need to speak loudly and clearly when communicating with ATC.
cards.referenceTextZh:
例如，飞行员应该使用标准术语。
我们应该正确地复诵。
当对指令不确定时，我们应该和ATC确认。
还有，飞行员在与空中交通管制人员沟通时要大声、清晰。

cards.audioText: What's your opinion about walk around check? Do you think it is necessary?
cards.audioTextZh: 你如何看待绕机检查？你觉得它重要吗？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, the walk around check is very necessary.
Because we can find abnormal situation and correct it so as to avoid takeoff with malfunction.
cards.referenceTextZh:
是的，绕机检查是非常必要的。
因为我们可以发现非正常情况，然后改正，这样避免了带故障起飞。

cards.audioText: How could you avoid Air traffic control confusing your call sign with another similar callsigns?
cards.audioTextZh: 如何防止管制员将你的呼号和别的相似呼号混淆？
cards.referenceText: When there are similar flight call signs in the airspace, one should actively inform the controller and use the complete call sign for communication throughout the process. Carefully listen to the instructions. If there is any doubt, immediately request confirmation and repeat the instructions completely. The crew members need to coordinate in listening and reminding each other to ensure the instructions are accurately received and to prevent confusion.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当空域有相似航班呼号时，应主动告知管制员并全程使用完整呼号通话。仔细监听指令，如不确定立即请求证实，并完整复诵。机组间需协同监听提醒，确保指令准确接收，严防混淆。

cards.audioText: What may be the possible results if you extend your flaps beyond your altitude limitation?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果在超过飞行高度限制时放襟翼，可能会产生什么样的后果？
cards.referenceText: Extending the flaps beyond the speed or altitude limits is extremely dangerous as it will cause structural damage to the aircraft, lead to severe dives or rollouts out of control, and may trigger vibration, increasing the risk of the aircraft crash.
cards.referenceTextZh: 超过速度或高度限制放襟翼是非常危险的，因为它将会导致飞机出现结构损伤，引发剧烈俯冲或滚转失控，并可能诱发颤振，造成飞机事故。

cards.audioText: Is there a specific route for the walk around check? What is the purpose of it?
cards.audioTextZh: 在绕机检查时，你们有一个特定的路线吗？这样做的目的是什么？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, there is. We should walk clockwise to check the aircraft.
In this way, we can find out some abnormal situation of the aircraft, and ensure flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我们有一个特定的路线。我们应该沿着顺时针方向检查飞机。

cards.audioText: Can you introduce the operation of the flaps in normal situation?
cards.audioTextZh: 你可以介绍下，在正常情况下的襟翼操作流程吗？
cards.referenceText: Flap operation is a crucial procedure during the takeoff and landing phases of an aircraft, as it directly affects flight safety. It is well known that the main function of flaps is to increase lift and drag, allowing aircraft to maintain stable flight at lower speeds. When operating flaps, we need to ensure a strict match with the flight stage and speed. When operating the flaps, we follow the steps of "adjustment - inspection - confirmation", and the captain and the co-pilot will conduct cross-checks.
cards.referenceTextZh: 襟翼操作是飞机起飞和着陆阶段一个至关重要的程序，它直接关系到飞行安全。众所周知，襟翼的主要作用是增加升力和阻力，允许飞机在更低的速度下保持稳定飞行。在操作襟翼时，我们需要保证与飞行阶段和速度严格匹配。在操作襟翼时，我们遵守“调整-检查-确认”的步骤，机长与副驾会进行交叉检查。

cards.audioText: What's your company's procedures to deal with radio failure?
cards.audioTextZh: 你们公司应对通信失效的流程是什么？
cards.referenceText:
If we encountered this situation, first we would check microphone and earphone, check transmitter and receiver.
Then, we will try transmitting blind, and set squawk to 7600.
cards.referenceTextZh:
如果遇到这种情况，首先要检查麦克风和耳机，检查发射器和接收器。
然后，我们试着盲发，并将应答机设为7600。

cards.audioText: What will the cabin crew do before departure?
cards.audioTextZh: 空乘在起飞前会做什么？
cards.referenceText: First of all, they will have a pre-flight briefing to learn about the flight mission, aircraft type, crew personal, and do a good job in task-sharing. Then, they will make sure that the cabin equipment is in good condition. After passengers board the plane, they will conduct cabin inspection to correct passengers' behaviors threatening flight safety in time to ensure flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先，他们会开准备会，了解航班任务、机型、机组人员，做好任务分工；再次，他们会检查客舱设备完好。等乘客登机后，他们会进行客舱检查，及时纠正乘客威胁飞行安全的行为，确保飞行安全。

cards.audioText: What special attention will you pay to the flap operation if you carry out flight in winter seasons?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果在冬季进行飞行，你会对襟翼操作给予怎样的特别关注呢？
cards.referenceText: During the cold winter season, aircraft are easily to suffer from icing condition. Therefore, when operating the flaps, we must ensure that there is no ice on the flaps at all times.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在寒冷的冬季，飞机容易遇到积冰，因此我们在操作襟翼时，需要时刻保证襟翼上没有积冰。

cards.audioText: Under what circumstances is a holding instruction necessary?
cards.audioTextZh: 在什么样的情况下，需要发布等待指令？
cards.referenceText: Under the following circumstances, ATC may issue holding instructions to pilots: during traffic flow control due to air route congestion or airport busyness; when the destination airport's weather does not meet standards, the runway is occupied (e.g., another aircraft has not vacated in time), or adverse weather or military activities occur along the route, preventing the aircraft from proceeding as planned; when the aircraft itself experiences special situations such as mechanical failure or a passenger/crew member falling ill, the flight crew may request to hold.
cards.referenceTextZh: 当出现以下情况时，管制员会向飞行员发布等待指令：因航路拥堵、机场繁忙，机场实施流控时；因目的地机场天气不达标、跑道占用（如其他飞机未及时脱离），或航路出现恶劣天气、军事活动等情况，飞机无法按计划飞行时；当飞机本身出现机械故障、机上人员突发疾病等特殊情况时，机组可能主动请求等待。

cards.audioText: During flight operation, who is responsible for the radiotelephony communication with ATC?
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行运行中，谁负责和管制员进行无线电陆空通话？
cards.referenceText: Usually PM will do the communication with ATC, sometimes PF.
cards.referenceTextZh: 一般是负责通讯的飞行员负责与管制员进行交流，有时也是主操纵飞行员。

cards.audioText: Do you check whether the runway is good in your daily flight?
cards.audioTextZh: 在日常飞行中，你会检查跑道是否良好吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, absolutely. Because the runway condition is crucial for pilots. If the runway condition is not good, there may be some accidents, for example, if the brake action is too poor, we may overrun the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，绝对是。因为跑道情况对飞行员至关重要。如果跑道情况不好，会发生事故，譬如，如果跑道刹车性能不好，我们可能会冲出跑道。

cards.audioText: As a part of you pre-flight planing, how do you determine whether the runway is good?
cards.audioTextZh: 做为飞行计划的一部分，你如何确定跑道状况是否良好？
cards.referenceText: We can get the runway condition from ATC and previous pilot report, then we can decide whether the runway is good or not for us to take off and land.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们可以从管制员和前序飞行员报告中得知跑道情况，因此来决定跑道情况是否有利于起飞和着陆。

cards.audioText: If controller asks you to hold in a certain holding fix, what information should be obtained?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果管制员让你在特定的等待点等待，你需要获取什么信息？
cards.referenceText: Well, I should know the reasons for the holding as well as inbound track, outbound time, holding altitude, left/right holding and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我需要了解的信息有：等待的原因以及入行航迹、出航时间、等待高度、左/右等待等。

cards.audioText: What special attention would you pay to the flaps during operation in winter seasons?
cards.audioTextZh: 冬季运行期间，您会特别注意襟翼的哪些方面？
cards.referenceText: During winter operations, we need to ensure there is no ice accumulation on the flaps during the pre-flight inspection, as ice can disrupt the aerodynamic profile of the flaps and even cause mechanical jams. During the approach phase, it is advisable to appropriately delay the extension of flaps and landing gear.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在冬季运行时，我们在绕机检查过程中需要注意襟翼上没有积冰，因为积冰会影响襟翼的气动外形，甚至导致卡阻；在进近过程中，考虑适当推迟放下襟翼和起落架的时机。

cards.audioText: Suppose you fly tomorrow, will you prepare the flight today? How?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果你明天有飞行任务，今天你会进行飞行前准备吗？怎么准备？
cards.referenceText:
Yes, I will prepare the flight.
Such as don't drink; have a good rest; learn information about airport chart.
cards.referenceTextZh:
是的，我会进行相关准备。
比如：不喝酒，好好休息，了解机场图。

cards.audioText: Do you brief your cabin crew members in the preflight preparation?
cards.audioTextZh: 在飞行前的准备工作中，你是否向乘务人员做过飞行前讲评？
cards.referenceText: Yes, we will have a briefing in the briefing room.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，我们会在讲评室进行飞行前讲评。
